task.title: Grocery list: make the unsaved-changes notice obvious
task.description:
Owner feedback from phone testing (2026-11-18): 'You have unsaved changes.' is very small and not noticeable. It should be red and more obvious.

Today (components/grocery/grocery-list-editor.tsx): a small grey line under the 'Update list' button in the List summary panel, which on a phone sits below all the items.

Wanted:
- A clearly visible notice when the list has unsaved edits: red (danger colour), bold, with an icon, not colour alone.
- On a phone it should be visible without scrolling to the bottom, for example a sticky bar above the bottom nav holding the notice and the 'Update list' button.
- Keep role=status so screen readers announce it.

Related: 'Update list' is now disabled until there is something to save.
